close_reason: False positive: lifecycle.rs line 1300 calls idx.commit() after index_article. Confirmed via grep.
description:
## Why This Exists

Search articles are indexed via search_index.index_article() in the POST pipeline. However, Tantivy requires an explicit commit() call followed by reader.reload() to make new documents visible to searchers (ReloadPolicy::Manual). Without commit(), articles accumulate in the Tantivy writer buffer and are never visible to SEARCH commands until the next explicit commit (which currently only happens in tests).

The search/mod.rs::commit() function exists but is not called from the lifecycle POST path. The module-level doc says 'should be called after a batch of index_article calls' but no caller in the POST pipeline does this.

## Acceptance Criteria

Call search_index.commit() after each successful POST, or batch commits at a configurable interval. Add a test that verifies indexed articles are searchable after POST without manual commit.
title: search::TantivySearchIndex::commit not called after index_article in POST pipeline
